# Luca Ramseyer — Brand

> Visual identity and design system for the Luca Ramseyer / lram.ch personal brand (systems, cybersecurity, software). Quiet, precise, Swiss restraint: paper-and-ink palette with a dark mode, Schibsted Grotesk with a Cormorant Garamond wordmark, one muted-red accent used sparingly. Mobile first.

When designing or coding anything for this brand, use the tokens verbatim and follow the rules. Never invent colours or fonts; red is an accent only; keep the wordmark's wide letter-spacing; design for phones first.

- [Ready-made CSS](https://pages.lram.ch/brand.css): tokens (light + dark) and components in one stylesheet.

## Core
- [Agent rules](AGENTS.md): authoritative, concise instructions for coding agents.
- [Design tokens (JSON)](tokens.json): single source of truth — colour, type, spacing, radius.
- [Tokens (CSS variables)](tokens/tokens.css): drop-in for plain CSS.
- [Tokens (Tailwind v4 theme)](tokens/theme.css): drop-in for Tailwind.

## Reference
- [Style guide (Markdown)](style-guide.md): full guide in plain text.
- [Style guide (HTML)](style-guide.html): human-facing guide; also embeds tokens as JSON (`#brand-tokens`).

## Assets
- [assets/](assets/): wordmark/mark, favicons, social avatars and banners.

## Licensing
- Fonts are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (free for commercial use). See [fonts/README.md](fonts/README.md) for when a licence file must be shipped.
- [Schibsted Grotesk OFL](fonts/OFL-SchibstedGrotesk.txt) · [Cormorant Garamond OFL](fonts/OFL-CormorantGaramond.txt)
- Include the matching OFL file only when redistributing the font files (self-hosting webfonts or bundling in an app); not for CDN use or document exports.
